title: Molly and the Hens Who Followed the Boxes
synopsis: Dan takes the long farm road to deliver sacks of proper hen feed, while Molly and Rex discover that the hens want to inspect every box.
continuity_state: Before: Dan has delivered the garage cones and Pine Park rain gauge. The farm still has dry hay stored for sheep and goats and three hens that need their own balanced feed. After: Dan delivers sealed sacks of balanced hen feed to Green Gate Farm via the long farm road. Farmer Ruth stores the feed in a closed, dry container in the red barn and later fills the hens' feeder. Molly and Rex reprise their one-wag greeting. Another boxed farm item remains to be delivered on a later day.
